press_references.value: Legacy appoints Dr. Scott Lundy as Chief Medical Officer to lead clinical strategy and research expansion

press_references.value: Legacy Launches Comprehensive Preservation & Testing Solution for Vasectomy Clinics

product_launches.description: Legacy launched a nationwide comprehensive vasectomy solution that combines pre-vasectomy sperm banking with rapid, mail-in post-vasectomy semen analysis aligned with AUA guidelines for vasectomy clinics and patients.

overview_description.description: Legacy provides a service for at-home sperm testing and cryopreservation, allowing individuals to take control of their fertility health from the comfort of their homes. Their semen analysis is conducted in CLIA-certified labs, ensuring high-quality testing without the need for direct doctor involvement. As America's largest at-home fertility clinic for men, Legacy empowers clients to understand their reproductive health and plan for the future effectively.

product.name: Sperm Freezing
product.description: An at-home sperm cryopreservation service that analyzes, freezes, and stores eligible sperm samples for potential use in future fertility treatment.
